hyundai ioniq 3|c-hatch.twin_note: Plausibility check Oct 2026: Hyundai's European press kit puts the IONIQ 3 on the Hyundai-Kia K3 platform (400 V, front-wheel drive, 2,680 mm wheelbase, the same as the Kia EV3); Wikipedia's infobox calls it 'E-GMP (400 V architecture)', which is Kia's name for the same hardware. Framed with the Kia EV4 (same 400 V front-drive hardware family, distinct body, 2,820 mm wheelbase) → tier 2. The EV3 and the K3 combustion/hybrid cars Kona, Niro and Seltos are relatives in the C-SUV class.
